name: World Capitals
description: World Capitals word search puzzles hide familiar capital-city names — Athens, Berlin, Cairo, Tokyo, Ottawa, Nairobi and more — for adults who enjoy geography without loud trivia buzzers. Free online grids include easy, medium, hard and large print. No timer, no account and no travel-brand promotions: just city names many readers already know from maps and news. Written for seniors and grown-up puzzlers who like clear letter patterns. Pair with Countries, Continents, Cities, Travel and Landmarks for a wider geography afternoon. Prefer bigger letters? Use large print. First visit? Read how to play, then choose a difficulty that feels like a stroll rather than a race.
